questions.text: What does the x × y = k formula describe?
options: The constant product invariant of an AMM

questions.text: When does impermanent loss become permanent?
options: When you withdraw liquidity at a different price ratio than when you deposited
When the pool runs out of tokens

questions.text: You set 5% slippage tolerance on a shallow pool. What's the most likely outcome?
options: Your swap executes at a much worse price than quoted

questions.text: What is the main advantage of concentrated liquidity over full-range LP?
options: Higher capital efficiency and more fees per dollar deposited

questions.text: What are the main risks of being a liquidity provider?
options: Impermanent loss and smart contract risk

questions.text: You provided $1,000 of ETH + $1,000 of USDC when ETH was at $2,000. ETH doubles to $4,000. Approximately what's your IL?
options: About 50% — you lost half your value

questions.text: You're about to swap $20,000 USDC. The pool has $50,000 total liquidity. What should you do?
options: Swap normally — pool size doesn't matter
Use a DEX aggregator to split across multiple pools and minimize price impact
Set 50% slippage tolerance just in case
Wait for the pool to grow
